items.q: Yes. But he was playing the soprano sax, and I tried to copy behind him. I'd buy all his records and listen to him. Sidney Bechet.

ctx.x: You'd heard records of Sidney Bechet.
Yes. But he was playing the soprano sax, and I tried to copy behind him. I'd buy all his records and listen to him. Sidney Bechet.
Because he hadn't made too many records by then.
